INTRO DATE
Oct (4, 2026

Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section]. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-
Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 18-F in the area bound
by:

A line 148.66 feet next south of and parallel to West 72nd Street; the public alley next
east of and parallel to South Union Avenue, a line 186.16 feet next south of and
parallel to West 72nd Street; and South Union Avenue

to those of RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 7215 S. Union Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
